name: corridorkey-desktop
description: Free desktop app for CorridorKey 2.0, Corridor Digital's AI green-screen keyer (Rust + ONNX Runtime).

scripts.dist:linux: tools/build_engine.sh && tools/build_trt_builder.sh && node tools/gen_cli_spec.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: tools/build_engine.sh --windows && node tools/gen_cli_spec.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: tools/build_engine.sh --mac && node tools/gen_cli_spec.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.gates: ./.hooks/check_electron_security.sh && node .hooks/check_theme_colors.mjs && node tools/list_loops.mjs --check && node tools/check_no_folds.mjs && node tools/check_wiki.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run gates && npm test && npm run test:reference && npm run test:farm
scripts.check:engine: cd engine-rs && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test

author: MarcelineVPQ
